question.worked_solution:
We proceed to factor the left-hand side by grouping:

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}^{3}-3{m}^{2}-2m+6 & = \\ ({m}^{3}-3{m}^{2})-(2m-6) & = \\ {m}^{2}(m-3)-2(m-3) & = \\ (m-3)\cdot {m}^{2}-(m-3)\cdot 2 & = \\ (m-3)({m}^{2}-2) & \end{aligned}
$$

Then, we solve $(m-3)({m}^{2}-2)=0$ by setting each factor equal to $0.$

- Setting the factor $(m-3)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}m-3 & =0 \\ m & =3.\end{aligned}
$$

- Setting the factor $({m}^{2}-2)$ equal to $0,$ we get

$$
\begin{aligned}{m}^{2}-2 & =0 \\ {m}^{2} & =2 \\ m & =\pm \sqrt{2}.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the solutions are $m=3,\,\pm \sqrt{2}.$
